gen.title: How daily interest and card payments work

cards.stem: What is the name for interest charged each day?
cards.quote: The interest charged daily is called the daily periodic rate.
cards.hint: Think about the rate applied each day.

cards.stem: How do many companies determine the interest you owe each day?
cards.quote: Many credit card companies calculate the interest you owe daily, based on your average daily account balance.
cards.hint: Recall what average is used for daily calculation.

cards.stem: When can you avoid paying interest on purchases if a grace period exists?
options: pay off your balance in full by the due date each month
keep a balance for the next month
pay only the minimum amount owed
cards.quote: If your card has a grace period, you can avoid paying interest on purchases if you pay off your balance in full by the due date each month.
cards.hint: Consider what full payment by the due date does.

cards.stem: Where does a payment above the minimum go first?
options: balance with the highest interest rate
balance with the lowest interest rate
cards.quote: the card issuer must generally apply the amount you pay over the minimum first to the balance with the highest interest rate
cards.hint: Remember which balance gets extra payment first.
